transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, doctor... I came in because of some things I've been noticing. The men down at the domino table, and sometimes even the announcer on the radio... they've been giving these little messages that are meant just for me. 

My wife, she tells me it's just regular talk and I shouldn't pay it no mind, but... I know they are warning me to be careful. So I figured I should come see you about it.
About how long have you been noticing these messages?
Well, it's been going on for a little while now. I'd say the voices and those special messages... they've been happening on and off for about nine months.
When you mention hearing voices, do you hear people talking when no one is actually there, or are you hearing real people speak and finding hidden meanings in their words?

Well... I suppose it's a bit of both. The messages, that's from real folks talking. But the voices... that happens when nobody else is around. 

Some afternoons, when the house is real quiet, I'll hear my old friend. I hear him call my name from out on the porch, or sometimes he's humming a choir song. It's clear... clear just like he is standing right there.
During these past nine months, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or depressed?
No, doctor, I wouldn't say I've felt sad or down like that. Just... well, just dealing with the things I told you about. I don't feel depressed, no.
Have you ever had periods where you felt unusually high, irritable, or full of energy and didn't need much sleep?

Yes, I do have times like that. There are weeks when I wake up feeling... well, just real bright and important. I'll have all this energy, laughing loud and talking real fast. 

But if somebody tries to slow me down, or if they start questioning me, I get pretty sharp with them. I just lose my patience real quick during those times.
Do you still hear the voices or notice those special messages during the times when your mood and energy feel normal?

Yes, I do. Actually, there was a quiet month recently... well, I was sleeping normally again, getting a full night's rest, and I wasn't full of all those big plans or feeling so riled up. But even then, I still heard my friend calling from the porch. And I still knew the radio was sending those messages just for me. So, yes, it happens even when I feel perfectly regular.
